title: Notification regarding Special Division Bench of Hon'ble The Chief Justice and Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh on 9th September,2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh on 09-09-2026 at 12:00 noon only for hearing WA No. 22

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphat, the 7th September, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ Iq't&/ It is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that there will be a Special Division Bench of Hon'ble The Chief Justice and
Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh on 09-09-2026 at 12:00 noon only for hearing WA No. 22
of 2026 \Th.armi Shimray and Anr. Vs. State of Manipur and 5 Ors.\ and CrI . h. Mo. 12 at
2026 \Chingakham Basanta Vs. National Investigation Agency\ and the connected
Miscellaneous matters.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ Iq 952- to Imphal, the 7th September, 2026
